text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A for a small gain and later buying it back at a higher price reminds me not to let the satisfaction of a realized gain replace a consistent view of the stock and my plan.","Selling Stock B at a sizable loss felt painful, but I should assess whether holding still makes sense rather than keep a position just to avoid realizing a loss.","After buying Stocks D and C, prices can still move against me; I should size purchases carefully and review the reasons for holding, without reacting to every monthly fluctuation."]}
